hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files."}}'   || true ;; esac

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"KNOWLEDGE GUARD: You are about to modify code. Confirm you have: (1) read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md, (2) queried the relevant community via graphify explain/query, (3) checked the Obsidian work log at ~/obsidian-brain/vault/Projects/LGD_USA_APP/Work Log.md for related issues, decisions, and recent sessions. If you have NOT done all three, stop and do them now before this edit proceeds."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"KNOWLEDGE GUARD: You are about to write/modify a file. Confirm you have: (1) read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md, (2) queried the relevant community, (3) checked the Obsidian work log for related issues/decisions/sessions. If not, stop and consult each source before writing."}}'

CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *git\ commit*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: You just committed code. Run `graphify update .` to update the knowledge graph, and write a session note to ~/obsidian-brain/vault/Projects/LGD_USA_APP/sessions/ with what changed and why."}}' ;; *git\ push*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: You just pushed. Check Railway deploy logs via Railway MCP get_logs. If deploy fails, log error to Obsidian errors/ and Axiom."}}' ;; esac
